resources.string: How do you want to see your Pokémon?
Black and white, like the Glyph Matrix
You can change it whenever you like in Settings.
Hello there! Welcome to the world of Pokémon!
My name is Oak! People call me the Pokémon Professor!
This world is inhabited by creatures called Pokémon! For some people, Pokémon are pets. Others use them for battles.
Myself… I study Pokémon as a profession. And you\'re going to help me!
Leave your phone face-down and locked. Pokémon will appear on your Glyph Matrix, and you can catch them with a long press.
Take this: your very own Pokédex! It records every Pokémon you register.
But enough about me. Tell me a little about yourself: what do you look like?
So your name is %1$s! Nice to meet you!
Oh, silly me! With so many Pokémon around, I never asked you…
Remind me, what do you look like?
%1$s! Of course, of course! I won\'t forget it again.
But enough about me. What\'s your name?
Oh! I almost forgot to give you something…
For now, only Pokémon from Kanto will show up. Keep filling your Pokédex and other professors will want to meet you.
I\'ve saved my number in your Pokégear. Give me a call and I\'ll tell you about any rumors I hear.
Your very own Pokémon legend is about to unfold! A world of dreams and adventures with Pokémon awaits! Let\'s go!
Hi! I\'m Professor Elm, from New Bark Town in Johto. Professor Oak has told me all about you!
Hey there! I\'m Professor Birch, from Littleroot Town in Hoenn. I\'d much rather be out in the field than stuck in a lab!
Hmm… So you\'re the trainer Oak keeps talking about. I am Rowan, from Sandgem Town in Sinnoh. I study how Pokémon evolve.
Hello! I\'m Professor Juniper, from Nuvema Town in Unova. I research the origins of Pokémon.
Take this: the %1$s Pokédex. From now on, Pokémon from %1$s can appear too!
I\'ve saved my number in your Pokégear. Call me whenever you like!
Ho! You\'ve collected all four regional Pokédexes! You\'re a true researcher.
Take this Town Map. With it, you can choose which regions\' Pokémon appear.
Incredible! You\'ve registered all %1$d Pokémon. The national Pokédex is complete!
Take this Shiny Charm. They say it attracts shiny Pokémon.
From now on, shinies will be three times as common. Keep looking!
So you\'ve made it to Unova! Your Pokémon must be working hard alongside you.
Take this Exp. Share. While it\'s on, every Pokémon in your team earns experience, a little less than the one you\'re training.
Some trainers prefer to train just one Pokémon at a time. Do you want it switched on?
You can switch it on and off from your Bag. Pick your team from each Pokémon\'s details in the PC.
You\'ll find it in your Bag. Keep up the good work!
Hello! It\'s %1$s. I\'ve heard something you\'ll want to know…
Take this: the %1$s. They say %2$s won\'t show up without it.
Good luck! Call me if you find anything.
You\'ve registered %1$d of the %2$d Pokémon from %3$s.
There\'s still a lot to discover. Keep that phone face-down!
You\'re making good progress. Keep it up!
By the way, I heard a rumor…
I haven\'t heard any rumors yet. Grow your Pokédex and I\'m sure something will come up.
You need the %1$s Pokédex to hear about this one.
Hey there! You\'ve caught quite a few Pokémon. Do you like fishing too?
Take this Old Rod. Use it from your Bag and water Pokémon will bite for a while.
You again! You\'re turning into a real angler. This Good Rod hooks better Pokémon.
A hundred catches already? Here, my most prized possession: the Super Rod!
Only one rod can be used at a time, so pick the one for the Pokémon you\'re after. Good luck!
Welcome! %1$d kinds of Pokémon registered… You must be tired of meeting the same ones again and again.
Here, try this Repel, on the house. While it\'s on, Pokémon you already have will stay away.
You again! %1$d kinds of Pokémon already… Now you must be looking for the ones you let go.
Take this Super Repel. While it\'s on, only Pokémon you don\'t have in your PC come close, even ones you\'ve registered before.
Only one repel works at a time. Legendary Pokémon aren\'t scared off by either, but shinies are, so keep that in mind!
You can switch it on and off from your Bag. Come back anytime!
Hey, you! Did you know bug Pokémon go crazy for Honey? I spread it on trees to find them.
Here, have a jar! Spread it from your Bag and, for an hour, Pokémon with a sweet tooth will come.
It works like a fishing rod: only one of them at a time. I hope you find a Heracross!
Oh, you have the Johto Pokédex! Then you\'ll want to meet baby Pokémon, like Pichu or Togepi. They only hatch from Eggs.
Whenever you catch a Pokémon, you might find an Egg. You can carry up to three.
Eggs hatch while your phone stays locked: some take 2 hours, others 5 or 10. You can check on them on the Home screen.
When one hatches, the baby appears on your Glyph Matrix. Catch it with a long press! Hatched Pokémon are more likely to be shiny, too.
Here, take this Egg to get started. Look after it!
It won\'t evolve: it\'s holding an Everstone.
It\'ll be ready to evolve: you choose into what from its details.

Tap a berry, then a Pokémon to give it or an empty plot to plant it.
Choose a berry to plant. It grows while your phone is locked, and every stage it gets watered gives one more berry. Water-type Pokémon in the Garden water it for you.
No berries yet. Your Pokémon bring them when they\'re fond of you, and the ones you plant give more.
No decorations yet. Pokémon that are very fond of you bring them now and then.
Tap a Pokémon to give it this berry, or an empty plot to plant it.
%1$s brought you a decoration! It\'s in your chest.
New background for the Garden! It\'s in your chest.
Planted! It grows while your phone is locked.
%1$d%% grown. It grows while your phone is locked.
Watered! It\'ll give one more berry.
Nobody lives in your Garden yet. Add Pokémon to your team from their details in the PC, or start training one.
Tap a Pokémon to pet it, double tap to see how it\'s doing, hold it to carry it around.
Give it a berry (%1$d more today):
%1$s loved it! That\'s its favorite flavor.
%1$s has had enough berries for today.
Your Garden is full: double tap a decoration to put it away.
Hold a decoration to move it, double tap it to put it away.
%1$s is very happy! Come back tomorrow for more.
It doesn\'t know you very well yet.
It adores you! You couldn\'t be any closer.
With high friendship, it evolves when it levels up: %1$s
A quiet notification with a button to throw a Poké Ball from the lock screen, without unlocking
How many Pokémon are waiting. On the Phone (4a) Pro, tap to catch them.
Ah, one more thing! Your phone plays a little differently.
When a Pokémon is waiting, a Poké Ball lights up on the back of your phone.
Open the app to see who it is, and throw a Poké Ball to catch it!
You can also throw them from the widgets on your home screen. Good luck!
A Poké Ball on the Glyph Matrix, and catching from the app and widgets
For those who know where to tap
The next Pokémon waiting and a Poké Ball to throw, as on the Phone (4a) Pro
On the waiting Pokémon widget, while catching with the phone is on
Pokémon, Eggs and training keep going when you unlock your phone, just like when it\'s locked.
Only Pokémon from the selected regions can appear. At least one must stay on.
A gift from %1$s. Pokémon from %2$s can appear.
A gift from Professor Oak. Choose which regions\' Pokémon can appear.
A key item from %1$s. Without it, %2$s won\'t appear.
A gift from Professor Oak. While your phone is locked, your whole team earns experience, a little less than the Pokémon you\'re training.
A gift from the clerk. Keeps away wild Pokémon you have in your PC, shinies included. Legendary Pokémon aren\'t scared off.
Only Pokémon missing from your PC
A gift from a Bug Catcher. For an hour, Pokémon that love sweet things come to taste it. Like the rods, only one works at a time.
Its scent draws Pokémon in: for an hour, they appear twice as fast. It\'s used up when you light it.
The reward from Professor Oak for completing the Pokédex. Shiny Pokémon are three times as common.

Your team hangs out here, brings you gifts and loves being petted.
Berries grow while your phone is locked. Water-types water them and Grass-types make them grow faster.
They relax and grow fond of you while your phone is locked. With anyone here, Eggs hatch sooner.
Tap to bring a Pokémon or send it back. Each one lives in a single place.
Nobody lives here yet. Tap Residents to bring Pokémon from the PC.
%1$s will be gone for good. This can\'t be undone.
Favorites and your training partner can\'t be released.
Tap the counter to cook, or the TV for today\'s tip.
There are no berries in the chest. Grow some in the Orchard.
%1$d of %2$d. The mix decides the flavor.
Tap when the arrow passes your marker!
A Water-type living in the Orchard waters the plants all by itself.
Every time a berry plant gets watered, it gives one more berry at harvest.
Berry plants take about eight hours to go from sprout to berries.
In the Hot Springs, Pokémon grow fonder of you while your phone is locked, and Eggs hatch sooner.
Every Pokémon has a favorite flavor. You\'ll find it in its details.
Pokéblocks made with its favorite flavor make a Pokémon happiest. The faster you blend, the better!
Petting a Pokémon in town makes it like you more, up to ten times a day.
Your team grows a little closer every day just by being together.
Pokémon that love you train a bit harder and earn more experience.
Some Pokémon only evolve once they love you. Eevee becomes Espeon by day and Umbreon by night.
Every Pokémon you release from the PC leaves you a Rare Candy.
In the PC you can search by type: try typing «water».
